items.title: Make a shortlist
items.detail: Dream, target and safe universities. Don't go by the name alone, look at the course.

items.title: Book your test date
items.detail: IELTS, TOEFL or PTE, whichever you need. Keep time in hand for one retake.

items.title: Write your first SOP draft
items.detail: Tell your story, don't repeat your resume. The first draft will be rough, and that's fine.

items.title: Ask for LORs early
items.detail: Tell your professor or manager well in advance. Everyone is busy at the last minute.

youtube.title: Planning to study abroad? Start these 4 things now
youtube.description:
Planning to study abroad next year? Start these 4 things now: your shortlist, your test date, the first draft of your SOP, and asking for LORs early.

Start early and you won't have last-minute stress.

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com

EduAbroad: Run by Harvard-Cambridge Alumni. 100% private. You contact us, we never contact you first.
